title: The One in the Corner
subtitle: 艺术殿堂 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）
meta: 主题语境：艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）　|　核心词汇：beauty　|　正文 326 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 beauty 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1950 my aunt was taken to see ① a beauty in a frame and said the frame was the expensive part. The ② beauty, meaning the painting and not the quality, was nine inches high and was hung too low for eleven years; a beauty, she said, is the only thing that is improved by being looked at badly.

Every ③ beauty in that gallery had been cleaned twice, and the ④ beauty in the corner, meaning the one nobody stopped at and not either of those, was the only one she ever went back to. A beauty, my mother said, is nine parts light and one part somebody willing to stand still; my aunt said the light is the part they charge for.

My grandfather meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ beauty was the whole of the sentence, meaning the quality and not the picture. The ⑥ beauty, meaning the excellence and not any of that, is the only thing in an argument that settles it without being right; a beauty, he said, is either something in a frame or the only word that means both a picture and a quality. She said the quality came first.

By 1967 the ⑦ beauty had become a photograph in a book, and the book had become an argument about who had painted it. The ⑧ beauty of the whole thing, my aunt wrote in May, was nine inches of paint and eleven years of standing still; a beauty, she said, is either the picture in the corner or the reason you learned to look. He said the looking was the part nobody taught.

The ⑨ beauty I remember is the one in the corner, which was worth nothing then and is worth everything now. A ⑩ beauty, my mother said in 1969, is the only thing that improves by being ignored; every beauty, she said, is a quality that has agreed to look like a picture. She said the quality was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 美的作品；美人（画中人／那幅画）
B. n. 那幅画（指画本身，与“美”这种品质相对）
C. 固定搭配：be taken to see a beauty 被带去看一件美的作品
D. n. 美的作品（指美术馆里每一件）
E. n. 美的作品（指角落那一件）
F. n. 美；美好（指句子里的那种品质）
G. n. 美（抽象：优秀、卓越这件事）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The beauty, meaning the painting and not the quality
beauty was the whole of the sentence
the beauty had become a photograph in a book
The beauty of the whole thing
A beauty, my mother said in 1969

answers.why: be taken to see a beauty 意为“被带去看一件美的作品”，1950 年姑姑被带去看画框里的一件作品，她说画框才是贵的那部分。
beauty 意为“那幅画（美的作品）”，指画本身而不是美这种品质，它高九英寸，挂得太低，挂了十一年。
beauty 指美术馆里每一件美的作品，每一件都被清洗过两次。
beauty 指角落那一件（没人停下看的那一件），是唯一她会回头再看的。
beauty 意为“美、美好”，指句子里的那种品质，祖父说 beauty 就是那个句子的全部。
beauty 为抽象用法，指优秀、卓越这件事，是争论里唯一不必正确却能定分止争的东西。
beauty 意为“美的作品”，到 1967 年这个 beauty 成了书里的一张照片。
beauty 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，姑姑五月写道，整件事权衡下来是九英寸的颜料和十一年的驻足。
beauty 意为“美的作品”，我记得的是角落那一件，那时一文不值，如今价值连城。
beauty 为抽象总称，母亲说美是唯一会因为被忽视而变好的东西。
